acceptanceCriteria: A full per-package run of go test ./... and interop/cem01-go on native Windows at a named origin/main sha is retained (pass/fail/skip per package, Go and Git versions, host spec).
Every failing package is triaged into a filed ticket (confirmed bug, test-portability gap, or documented unsupported surface) with its reproduction; none is left unexplained.
The supported-platform statement in the release docs names what Windows qualification covered and what it did not.
body: Today Windows is only cross-compiled and type-checked (make windows-vet; GOOS=windows go build/vet in ci.yml). No Corvint test has ever executed on Windows, so runtime defects (path separators, process groups, file locking, CRLF, long paths, git for Windows behaviour) are unobserved. The owner offered a quiet Windows machine over SSH (2026-10-22). Run with Go 1.27.2 and Git for Windows on a clean clone of origin/main, CGO_ENABLED=0, per package with the 30m timeout.
title: Qualify Corvint on native Windows: run the Go test suite on the owner's Windows host and triage every failure
